dedupe_keys.name: perimetre de concession du reseau de chaleur urbain

description: Périmètre de concession du réseau de chaleur urbain is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données comprend, à l'échelle de Bordeaux Métropole, les périmètres des concessions de réseaux de chaleur urbain ou les périmètres d'influence des réseaux de chaleur, c'est-à-dire les périmètres au sein desquels une demande de raccordement peut être étudiée. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Infrastructure physique (réseau). Its keywords are cartographies, chaleur, énergie, concessions, data-gouv. The portal shows 32 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
